2609.04582.title: When Do Internal Probes Beat Reading the Answer? Miscalibrated Readouts and Behavior-Concealed Knowledge in Language Models
2609.04582.paper_summary: A 0.6B language model, asked to verify 1,200 logical conclusions (half valid, half corrupted by a single semantic edit), answers YES every time. Judged by behavior it discriminates nothing; linear probes on its hidden states read the correct verdict at 0.96 AUC, transferring to unseen logical structures and separating foils built from exactly the words of the true conclusion (0.90). We ask where the verdict is lost, and find the dominant failure is a single scalar. The verdict survives to the model's own output logits (margin AUC 0.89) along a well-aligned readout direction; a saturated decision threshold, offset by +4.6 sigma, erases it. The diagnosis generalizes: across 90 semantic-label configurations of a five-model, three-family factorial, behavioral accuracy collapses onto a single function of threshold offset (Spearman -0.93) while margin ranking moves far less. Across a 13x scale range, internal knowledge saturates while free-form behavior is non-monotone: an 8B model underperforms its 4B sibling through an answer-channel failure rather than the threshold; forced-choice accuracy is monotone. The diagnosis is actionable: a one-parameter correction, never fit on evaluated structures, repairs behavior from 50% to 81% (0.6B); calibrated margin decoding recovers 94% at 8B; few-shot prompting works the same way, recentering the threshold (+4.6 sigma to 0.0 sigma) while preserving ranking. Comparing probe to margin separates three regimes: concealed, miscalibrated, and undetected. On a maze task built so foils carry no surface cues, the audit correctly reports the third. In the standard generation setting, answer-surface features and heuristic labels reproduce published probing results without any internal access.
2609.04582.paper_summary_zh: 一個0.6B的語言模型，在被要求驗證1,200個邏輯結論（一半有效，一半因單一語義編輯而失效）時，每次都回答YES。根據行為判斷，它對任何事物都沒有歧視；對其隱藏狀態進行線性探測時，正確判決的AUC為0.96，能轉移到未見的邏輯結構，並能分辨出完全由真實結論的單詞構成的對照（0.90）。我們詢問判決在哪裡丟失，發現主要的失敗是一個單一的標量。判決在模型自身的輸出logits中存活（邊際AUC 0.89），沿著一個良好對齊的讀出方向；一個飽和的決策閾值，偏移+4.6 sigma，抹去了它。診斷結果具有普遍性：在一個五模型、三家族的因子中，90個語義標籤配置下，行為準確性崩潰到一個閾值偏移的單一函數（Spearman -0.93），而邊際排名變化不大。在一個13倍的範圍內，內部知識飽和，而自由形式的行為則是非單調的：一個8B模型在回答通道失效的情況下表現不如其4B同伴，而不是閾值；強制選擇準確性是單調的。這一診斷是可操作的：一個單參數的修正，從未在評估結構上擬合，將行為從50%修復到81%（0.6B）；經過校準的邊際解碼在8B時恢復94%；少量樣本提示以相同方式運作，重新中心化閾值（+4.6 sigma到0.0 sigma），同時保持排名。比較探測與邊際分開了三個範疇：隱藏的、錯誤校準的和未檢測的。在一個迷宮任務中，對照不攜帶任何表面線索，審計正確地報告了第三種情況。在標準生成設置中，答案表面特徵和啟發式標籤重現了已發表的探測結果，而無需任何內部訪問。
